title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Microsoft Copilot usage report for GCC High and DoD
summary: The roadmap facts and both governance control paths are supported. The licensing model needs correction: Microsoft's Copilot overview names licences for the usage report, although it does not settle whether the administrator viewing it personally needs a licence. Two minor clarifications concern concealed information and alternative report navigation.
